text.p: Marinex Multimedia Corp., a developer of content for the Internet and CD-ROMs, said Tuesday it acquired farm equipment retailer Texas Equipment Co. Inc. in a stock deal worth about $48.4 million.

Marinex Multimedia will offer 16.85 million of its 25 million shares outstanding for the closely held company, it said. New York-based Marinex's stock was unchanged at $2.875 on the Nasdaq bulletin board in early afternoon trading.

"A solid, well-established, low-tech company with great growth potential is an excellent anchor for a pioneering high-tech, Internet-based content provider," Marinex President Stuart Platkin said in a statement.
Seminole, Texas-based Texas Equipment, a dealer for John Deere farm equipment, has assets of $8.5 million, shareholder equity exceeding $3 million and annual revenues of $25 million, Marinex said.
